title: Area and Security Lighting Rental LED Conversion of Legacy Fixtures
content:
A legacy **Area and Security Lighting Rental** fixture — one that is not installed new — is converted at the cooperative's initiative to its LED conversion target when it fails or during a scheduled conversion, at the conversion charge, which is 0.00 for every fixture. The rental changes to the LED fixture's monthly rental from the next billing period, the contract term does not restart, and a member may not keep a failed legacy fixture.

## The three legacy fixtures and their LED replacements

| Legacy fixture | Converted to |
|---|---|
| HPS 100W Security Light | LED 40W Security Light |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | LED 110W Flood Light |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | LED 70W Area Light |

## What a conversion changes and what it leaves alone

| Item | After the conversion |
|---|---|
| Fixture on the rental | The LED conversion target, with a new fixture number |
| Monthly rental | The LED fixture's monthly rental, from the next billing period |
| Contract term | Does not restart |
| Charge to the member | The conversion charge, 0.00 |
| Whose initiative | The cooperative's |

## Questions answered

**When does a legacy fixture get converted?**
When it fails, or during a scheduled conversion. Either way the conversion is the cooperative's initiative.

**May a member ask to keep a failed mercury vapor or HPS light as it is?**
No. A member may not keep a failed legacy fixture; it is converted to its LED conversion target.

**When does the new rental show on the bill?**
From the next billing period after the conversion. The billing period in which the conversion takes place is billed at the legacy fixture's monthly rental.

**Does the member start a new term with the LED fixture?**
No. The contract term does not restart on conversion.

### Hypothetical case

A Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light over a hog barn fails in mid-month. The cooperative converts it to the LED 70W Area Light at no charge to the member. That month's rental is still billed at the Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light's monthly rental of 13.10; from the next billing period the rental is the LED 70W Area Light's 12.40, and the contract term continues without restarting.
